channel.title: Cant install Tor browser
channel.description:
i was trying install tor browser, but i get this error when open Tor Browser Downloader:
**ERROR**: torproject org could not be reached.
Possible reasons:
* www torproject org /dist/ torbrowser is down * download location changed
Please check:
Start menu → System → systemcheck or in Terminal: systemcheck or in Terminal with debugging: systemcheck -v
If systemcheck reports no problems with internet activity and downloading Tor Browser keeps failing, please report a bug!
(Debugging information: curl_status_message: \[112\] - \[helper-scripts curl-prgs (not curl!) reports: statusfile does not exist.\])
i dont find any information how to fix this issue, thank you
